title: senecio patagonicus var. lobatifolius
intro: Senecio patagonicus var. lobatifolius, commonly known as Patagonian ragwort or Patagonian groundsel, is a plant species within the daisy family that is native to Argentina and Chile. The health benefits of Senecio patagonicus var. lobatifolius include its potential to act as an anti-inflammatory agent and to exhibit antioxidant properties. Its therapeutic actions include its use in traditional medicine for the treatment of digestive issues and as a remedy for fever. The bioactive constituents of Senecio patagonicus var. lobatifolius include sesquiterpene lactones, phenolic compounds, and triterpenoids, which may contribute to its medicinal properties.
